Name: Stardew Valley - Roguelike Redux for 1.6
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
[size=4]With permission from[b] [u]TheTrain2000[/u], [/b]this is a 1.6 revival of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13614]original mod[/url], rebuilt so it exists alongside your normal farm instead of replacing it.[/size]
[size=4]
Descend into an increasingly dangerous series of randomized mine floors, fight monsters and bosses, collect temporary equipment and perks, take on curses, shop between stages, and see how far you can make it. [/size]

[size=4][b][u]About[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]This [/size][size=4]is an updated and slightly improved Stardew Valley 1.6 version of the original Stardew Roguelike.
The original mod transformed Stardew Valley into a standalone roguelike experience. This resurrected version takes a different approach and is now a place that exists inside your normal save.[/size]
[size=4]
A new entrance in the Mines leads to the Roguelike lobby. From there, you can begin a run without giving up your farm, relationships, quests, inventory, or normal Stardew progression.[/size]
[size=4]
Once a run begins, your regular equipment and character state are safely stored and replaced with the Roguelike starting setup. All  Fashion Sense outfits are preserved. When the run ends and you leave the Roguelike lobby, your normal farmer and inventory is restored.[/size]

[size=4][b][u]Features[/u][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4][b]Integrated into normal Stardew Valley saves[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]No separate Roguelike save required.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Your normal farm remains playable.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Enter and leave the Roguelike whenever you want.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Randomized Roguelike runs[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Procedurally generated mine layouts.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Increasingly dangerous monsters.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Random equipment and upgrades.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Temporary run-based progression.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Boss Floors[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Special boss encounters appear throughout the run.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Bosses use unique mechanics and arenas.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Challenge Floors[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Special floors break up normal combat with unique objectives and encounters.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Perks[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Build your character differently from run to run.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Perks can significantly change combat, movement, survivability, and item use.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Curses[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Powerful drawbacks can alter the rules of your run.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Active curses remain visible through Stardew's normal buff/debuff interface.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Merchant Floors[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Spend the gold earned during the run on equipment and supplies.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Sell excess resources, fish, and weapons.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Certain perks can alter merchant behavior.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Fishing[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Fishing remains useful during Roguelike runs and can provide additional resources and opportunities.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Multiple Difficulty Modes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Normal and Hard modes are available for players who want different levels of challenge.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][size=4][b]Run Statistics[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Track floors cleared, monsters killed, bosses defeated, gold earned, damage dealt, run duration, and completion information.[/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b][u]Multiplayer[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Multiplayer support is currently in active testing.[/size][size=4] This mod is being rebuilt so players can complete Roguelike runs cooperatively instead of treating the dungeon as a single-player-only activity.[/size]

[size=4]Current multiplayer systems include shared run startup, player-count monster scaling, spectator behavior, revival systems, and party progression safeguards.[/size]

[size=4]During ordinary floors, players are allowed some freedom to explore independently, but the party cannot become separated by more than one floor.[/size]

[size=4]If a player attempts to progress too far ahead you will receive the message [/size][b][size=4]“You must gather your party before venturing forth.” [/size][/b][size=4][i](points if you get the reference)[/i][/size]

[size=4]Boss floors, challenge encounters, disconnect behavior, and other multiplayer edge cases are still being tested before co-op is considered fully stable. For the most reliable experience during the current development release, single-player is recommended.  [/size]

[size=4][b]***For multiplayer bugs, logs from both the host and farmhand are extremely helpful***[/b][/size]

[size=4][u][b]Compatibility [/b][/u][/size]

[size=4]Large expansion mods and mods that heavily modify the Mines may require additional compatibility testing.
If you encounter a problem, please include your SMAPI log when reporting it.[/size]

[size=4]Not compatible with Android. [/size]
[heading][size=4][u]Requirements[/u][/size][/heading]
[size=4]Stardew Valley 1.6
SMAPI
SpaceCore[/size]

[heading][size=4][u]Installation[/u][/size][/heading]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Install the required dependencies.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Download Stardew Roguelike Resurrected.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Extract the mod into your Stardew Valley Mods [/size][size=4]folder.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Load your normal save.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Visit the Mines and use the Roguelike entrance to access the lobby.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]
As with any large gameplay mod, keeping a backup of important saves is recommended—particularly while multiplayer support is still being tested.[/size]

[heading][size=4][u]Bug Reports[/u][/size][/heading]
[size=4]When reporting a bug, please include:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]Your SMAPI log.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Stardew Valley version.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]SMAPI version.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Whether you were playing single-player or multiplayer.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]The Roguelike floor where the problem occurred.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]What you were doing immediately before the issue.[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Any relevant screenshots.[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]For multiplayer problems, please provide the SMAPI logs from [b]both players[/b] whenever possible.[/size]

[size=4][b][u]FAQ[/u][/b][/size]

[size=4]Q: Can I install this mid-save?[/size]
[size=4]A: Yes absolutely[/size]

[size=4]Q: Can I translate this?[/size]
[size=4]A: Yes totally. [/size]

[size=4]Q: Was AI used in this mod?[/size]
[size=4]A: No, this is just a compatibility overhaul. All assets belong to the original mod authors. [/size]

[size=4]Q: Will there be future content?[/size]
[size=4]A: Nope, this is only a revitalization of the original mod.[/size]
